source_row.stem: A near miss (an error caught before reaching the client) is analyzed by the quality team. This analysis focuses on:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Carrying fairly little analytic value, on the assumption that an error caught before reaching the client needs little further review","B":"Applying mainly to medication-related near misses, rather than to near misses across other types of care delivery","C":"Identifying contributing systemic factors, since near misses often reveal the same vulnerabilities as actual errors, without the harmful outcome","D":"Focusing mainly on assigning blame to whichever individual staff member happened to catch the error in time"}}
source_row.rationale: Near miss analysis focuses on identifying contributing systemic factors, since near misses often reveal the same underlying vulnerabilities as actual errors, providing valuable proactive learning opportunities without patient harm.
source_row.source_name: AHRQ — Near Miss Analysis and Patient Safety
